contradiction_assessment: No retained assertion specifically classifies the offered ERC variant as hybrid or forced-induction. Broader 3.6L hybrid records are a scope limitation requiring human consideration, not silently excluded evidence.
limitations: No explicit US ERC naturally aspirated/nonhybrid statement was found. Australian-to-US induction continuity and the ERC conventional-hardware association are derived. Catalog provenance and MY2020 introduction chronology are not conclusive alone. Regulatory material and retrospective FCA Y40 also describe MY2019 3.6L hybrid/eTorque applications without establishing that they are ERC; the proposal is restricted to the ten retained ERC offerings, not all MY2019 3.6L Wranglers.

proposed_conclusions.electrification_type: Propose none for the ten offered ERC configurations. US manual hardware descriptions distinguish conventional ESS starting equipment from an eTorque motor-generator with hybrid battery and launch assistance; the MY2019 catalog positively identifies conventional without-eTorque alternator applications and a separate ERG BSG application. US offering lineage binds the ten rows to ERC ESS; contemporary MY2020 powertrain materials separately introduce/describe V6 eTorque Sahara. The combined architecture/applicability judgment requires human adjudication; neither ESS terminology, missing eTorque words nor introduction chronology alone establishes nonhybrid status.
proposed_conclusions.engine_aspiration: Propose naturally_aspirated for the offered ERC 3.6L Pentastar V6 ESS. The MY19 technical guide positively classifies the same marketed family/ESS architecture as naturally aspirated; applicable US guide/specification lineage identifies ERC, its marketed dimensions and trim/body offerings. Induction continuity across these regional implementations is an engineering judgment supported by the combined evidence, not a direct US manufacturer assertion, code-equality proof or inference from absent turbo words alone.

representation: Research synthesis for human adjudication; not an original manufacturer document or approved classification
